description: EMOM schedule and end logging without a completion counter (REQ-011; C31, C32; R40, R43, R44, R84) on Round 7’s owners, carried by A3 TASK-117 (#743): the route’s EMOM is TimedWorkoutFlow (src/ui/timed-workout-flow.tsx), whose clock caption is the minute (Minute 3 of 10, with · Rest in the block’s rest window) and its state (Paused, Finished early, Time complete) — no Not started or Work caption — with each movement’s minute assignment and target (ODD MIN, Min 3 · 12 reps) and Now/Next; its end log is TimedResultLog (src/ui/timed-result-log.tsx) in the one “Log results” LoggingOverlay, opened as the schedule ends and from the card’s action: no minutes-completed counter, no completion question, no confirmation, each loaded movement’s actual load (no amount), the effort faces and the optional notes, where an exception is written. On the real /workout route (JOURNEY-011) through Start, a minute boundary and its rest, Pause/Resume, the natural end, Finish early, the section save, a reload, a failed save and its retry, and the History read: the saved block_results row carries the note in the block’s existing notes through the shell’s one writer and no minutes_completed, elapsed time or completion flag; an early finish keeps its actual stop; older stored records and saved rows read as before. The accepted gallery states /gallery/refinements?state=emom and ?state=cards (gallery bec4454) draw the same TimedWorkoutFlow. Each case keeps its build name; evidence/refinement/task-117/test-ledger.json records each Round 7 read. Every declared case must execute and pass; the other EMOM-named cases in the same file are selected by the pattern and must pass too, but are not declared here.
